title: Meta will soon face another high-stakes trial in US
raw_summary: With two convictions and nearly $1 billion in damages already stacked up, Meta will face another trial starting this week about alleged harms to children in a case brought by four US states. title: MeitY asks Meta to revamp algorithms, curb deepfakes and illegal content on platforms: Government sources
raw_summary: India's MeitY has urged Meta to revise its algorithms and provide a compliance roadmap.  The government seeks stronger detection and removal of harmful and manipulated content.  Meta's technical team met with MeitY officials to discuss existing content moderation systems.  The company acknowledged system gaps and outlined potential technical measures for synthetic content.  Discussions continue as India tightens regulations on synthetically generated information.

title: PhonePe, Razorpay chiefs say UPI will stay free for users, back sustainable model
